Where are the PRs to mathlib against lean nightlies being announced now? There hasn't been one in this channel since this thread and that's 12 days ago.

I made https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4-nightly-testing/pull/229 "by hand", and really should have posted it here. (Travel...) But other than that one everything has gone via the usual mechanism.
Maybe I'm saying "I no longer understand the system" then. Who is reviewing PRs which get merged in the once-a-month bonanza?
The point is that there were no such PRs between this one and and the one-off mathlib4-nightly-testing#229.

It's as you understand, except for that one-off that happened because we had fallen behind. Which happened because we were ignoring the bots reminders at #nightly-testing-mathlib > Mathlib bump branch reminders @ 💬 about work that needed to be done.

(That work can be done by anyone, but nearly always in practice by me, but I didn't get to these, more-or-less because of travel.)
